handoff.objective: Adversarial engineering and mathematical scope check of F3, F4, F6, F8; no official scientific promotion.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether retained exact checks and derived mathematical statements have a concrete counterexample, certificate defect, or scope overreach.
constraints: First derive the assigned mathematical quantities from statements and published parameters before reading producer result tables or verification outputs. Save that first derivation.
Fresh native session; no producer imports in a claimed independent computation.
Do not alter producer output, shared files, goal/hypothesis status, PR or git index.
Review source and complete certificates where tractable; report coverage limits explicitly.
No performance or breakthrough claim is promoted by this check. This is not a substitute for the repository scientific review/claim gates.
deliverables: Write-once blind-derivation.md, review.md and result.json with severity, precise file/statement and reproduction steps.
Executable independent checks and all retained command/failure logs in assigned review directory.

inference.runtime: native Codex isolated session; model binding unprobed

completion_gate: Every assigned joint has an outcome, evidence or stated coverage gap.
Failed controls remain failures and successful software checks are not performance evidence.
No unprovided review result or model attestation recorded.
handoff.return_format: PASS/issues/coverage, exact findings and artifact paths.

review_plan.claim_under_review: Correctness and scoped derived algebra in the assigned implementation packages, with no performance interpretation.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: Arithmetic certificates are expected to replay; ordinary-target solving costs and success laws remain incomplete. Check for overstated finite-domain completeness and dependence assumptions.

joint_owners.attack_plan: Independently derive the conditional useful-target-coefficient law; challenge label dependence and secret-scalar blindness. Zero-Q constructed dependencies are a negative control.
Independently derive the all-rational uniform-section counting formula; attack signed graph cancellation and rank with an unbalanced triangle and inverse-only rows.

Independently check the stated determinant/norm sufficient bound and interval cardinality convention. Challenge any multivariate extraction or impossibility inference with a known-root-offset fixture.
Independently derive the orbit-compression rank identity and scalar action. False compressed full-rank row is a negative control; symmetry must also be available to baselines.

blind_from: producer reported ranks and root counts
blindness.lifted_for: Only after saving blind-derivation.md from the statements and parameter definitions.

review_plan.proves_too_much_control: Each joint names a known invalid control or inference; it must not pass as valid.

blind_rederivation.method: Derive formulas and small exact parameter consequences independently before comparison.
